changelog:
- Initial release of the Pokémon GO PvP 培养查询技能 (v1.1) based on real data from PvPokeTW and game master stats.
- Supports querying rankings, best IVs, movesets, and user IV comparisons for specified Pokémon and league.
- Command: `/pvp 培养 <宝可梦> <联盟> [攻击/防御/生命]` with flexible input options (Chinese/English/nickname, league, IVs optional).
- Outputs real PvPokeTW rankings, top IV combinations, level/CP, and recommended moves; additional comparison fields if user IV provided.
- Strictly based on official data: no simulation, no product stats/output, no percentiles, and all outputs traceable to real sources.
- Implements 7-day cache strategy for ranking and game master data; fallbacks and clear prompts for missing data.
summary: Pokémon GO PvP 培养查询技能 v1.1。基于 PvPokeTW 真实排行数据 + gamemaster 基础种族值，提供排名查询、最佳 IV、用户 IV 对比等功能。
